exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to hold, to keep, to support
to support, to back, to second, to uphold
to stand, to withstand, to bear, to sustain, to endure
to retain, to hold, to withhold
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: держа́ть — to hold, to keep, to support; подде́рживать — to support, to back, to second, to uphold; вы́держать — to stand, to withstand, to bear, to sustain, to endure; удержа́ть — to retain, to hold, to withhold.

**задерживайте** — заде́рживать (imperfective): to detain, to hold back, to stop; to delay, to check; to arrest, to detain; to slow down, to retard, to delay, to hamper. Wiktionary: задержа́ть + -ивать.
